# cycle_dns_zones (Data Source)

Lists Cycle DNS zones in the hub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cycle_dns_zones" "all" {}

output "hosted_origins" {
  value = [
    for zone in data.cycle_dns_zones.all.zones : zone.origin
    if zone.hosted
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `zones` (Attributes List) The DNS zones in the hub. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `hosted` (Boolean) Whether this zone is hosted by Cycle (`true`) or linked (`false`).
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the DNS zone.
- `origin` (String) The origin (domain name) of the DNS zone, e.g. `example.com`.
- `state` (String) The current state of the DNS zone.
